messages:
Emily: Fw: FinCorp POC kickoff. Theyneed EU-only residency with strict subprocessor visibility + an optioned cold/failover runbook. Asking for clear pricing delta if we keep warm standby GPUs in another region. Can we collate answers by EOD? cc @rafael @olga
Rafael: Quick: do they want the tenant to be permanently pinned to an EU region, or do they expect per-request region headers? This affects KV cache locality and replication of embeddings.
Emily: Tenant pinning for production. For the POC theymay accept per-request but want the contract to mandate pinning.
Olga: Infosec questions: which subprocessors process logs/metrics for EU tenants? Are any traces or aggregated telemetry shipped to US analytics infra? Also need to know KMS key residency (customer keys vs platform keys).
Nikhil: Short answers: hosted EU uses GCP europe-west1 + europe-central1. Logs and object storage for EU tenants are stored in-region. Aggregated telemetry can be replicated to our analytics cluster in us-central but only if customer opt-in; we also offer a contract clause to disable replication. KMS: we support customer-managed keys in EU via partner KMS/HSM (additional setup).
Billing: Pricing ballpark: warm standby (reserved) +20% on top of baseline for predictable throughput (reserved GPUs). If you want cross-region read-replicas enabled for embeddings it's +8% storage/ops overhead. Cross-region egress for live traffic billed at cloud egress rates + 0.5c/1k tokens to account for routing overhead. I'll give line items.
Rafael: For the POC, sample routing policy we can show them (YAML):
```yaml
tenant: fincorp
routing:
  primary: europe-west1
  fallback_policy:
    - region: europe-central1
      type: automatic
    - region: us-central1
      type: manual_approval
  enforce_pin: true
  cache_policy:
    embeddings_local_only: true
    kv_replication: disabled
security:
  kms: customer_managed_eu_only
  log_replication: disabled_by_contract
```
Emily: Perfect. Can you also add a short failover workflow? They want US failover only if SRE triggers a runbook and customer signs off.
Nikhil: Failover workflow (short): 1) detect degraded EU region (health delta > 3m), 2) SRE triggers incident and notifies customer, 3) customer approves temporary manual failover via Console API, 4) routing toggles to manual fallback, 5) autoscaled standby serves traffic. All traffic logged; replay disabled until customer approves.
Olga: We'll prepare a subprocessors export (name, role, country, certs) and an FAQ re: telemetry. Also will confirm retention limits and offer DPA clause to prevent analytics replication.
legal_bot: Draft DPA addendum + subprocessor manifest will be uploaded to the deal folder. We recommend using SCCs + DPA for EU-only residency; can add an explicit "no-us-telemetry" clause.
Billing: I'll attach an itemized hosted vs dedicated vs private comparison and a 12-month committed reserved example showing the standby amortization.
Emily: Great. Rafael / Nikhil: can you both sign off on the config + failover text by EOD so I can bundle into the POC brief? We're scheduling the kickoff for Tue 09:00 CET.
Rafael: Iwill review and tweak the YAML (small change to cache policy) and ack by 17:30.
Nikhil: LGTM on workflow; will add a note about estimated RTO/RPO for embeddings.
Emily: Thanks team :raised_hands: — will send the updated POC invite and the customer-facing brief once you confirm.
